## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 concern the earlier arXiv:0809.2981v2 paper, not a full-text copy associated with DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\).
- claim-3 correctly records missing evidence but does not establish the requested positive certificate.
- No immutable full-text artifact, DOI linkage, integrity digest, indexed main-theorem passage, coefficient hypotheses, or exhaustive indexed audit of descriptions of \(J_v/A_+J_v\) is supplied.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Ingest a verifiable full-text copy associated with DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\), identify it immutably with integrity metadata, and provide exact indexed passages stating the main theorem, all coefficient hypotheses, definitions of \(J_v\) and \(A_+\), and every description or equivalent formulation of \(J_v/A_+J_v\).
